description: This PHP class 'TransferStats' provides a data structure to encapsulate information about an HTTP transfer, including request details, response, transfer time, and handler-specific statistics and errors.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: A class representing the data collected after an HTTP transfer operation, either successful or failed.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TransferStats instance with request, response, transfer time, error data, and handler statistics.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the original HTTP request object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response object if received.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerErrorData
methods.description: Returns error data from the handler, which could be an exception or error code.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI to which the request was sent.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Returns the total transfer time in seconds, if available.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Returns a specific handler statistic by name.
